proves.claim: compareClaimsWithMain returns { candidate, main, verdict } where the verdict is worse when the candidate p95 is over max(1.25 x main p95, main p95 + 50 ms) or over 1 s, and same otherwise.

api.io-claim-replay.compare-with-main.why: Without this test a claim-path change that slows every pull claim by 50 ms has no judge before it lands.

proves.claim: compareClaimsWithMain over a scratch board with main against main replays claims in a child process at each code tree, prints both p95s and reports same.

api.io-claim-replay.compare-real-path.why: The real child-process replay is what a gate would run; a stub alone would not catch a broken import or output shape.
